ruledOut: Enabling singleWriterReadCache in the gateway: one append per process nulls the memo
Extending the cache across appends: a reader could return a head another writer advanced
Treating the caching idea as unbuilt work: it is built, tested and enabled at one call site
Blaming fsync for ledger test time: the double process and 79-module load dominate
